step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify external actors: User icon representing mobile and web clients (UserConsumerMobile).
2. Identify AWS services drawn on the whiteboard: Route53, CloudFront, ELB, EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, Glue, S3, RedShift.
3. Trace edges based on visual arrows:
   - User -> Route53
   - Route53 -> CloudFront (for cached content)
   - Route53 -> ELB (for dynamic application requests)
   - ELB -> EKS (microservices cluster)
   - EKS -> ElastiCache (caching microservice requests)
   - EKS -> RDS (database queries)
   - RDS -> Glue (extracting data for ETL)
   - Glue -> S3 (storing extracted data in data lake)
   - S3 -> RedShift (loading data into data warehouse)
